name: AI Toolz Dir
conditions: Free $0 listing requires a backlink on your site: AI Toolz Dir — add it before submitting.
Free listings are listed within 48 hours after manual review; the listing stays permanent only as long as the backlink remains on your site.
requirements: AI tools; categories include Text Generation, Image Generation, Audio Generation, Video Generation, Chat Bots, Agents, Copilots, Free Tools.
All listings are manually reviewed; you get a confirmation email once approved.
Logo must be a direct link to a square image.
preparation: Logo URL — direct link to a square image.
Short Description (max 200 chars) and Full Description (max 500 chars).
Your email for the approval notification.
For the free lane: the specified anchor link already on your site; for paid: $25 one-time (no backlink, listed within 24h).
workflow: Fill Tool Name, Tool URL, Logo URL, Category, Short Description (0/200), Full Description (0/500), and Your Email.
Choose 'Get listed for free' (backlink required, ~48h) or 'Get listed for $25' (one-time, ~24h, no backlink).
Free: confirm the anchor link is live on your site before submitting.
Wait for the manual review and approval confirmation email.
watchFor: Free listing is permanently conditional — 'Listing stays permanent as long as the backlink remains on your site.'
Both tiers advertise a 'DR 63 do-follow backlink'; the free link's persistence depends on your badge staying up.
Character limits are tight: 200-char short description and 500-char full description.
Logo must be a hosted square image URL — have one ready; there is no upload widget described.
Paid 'listed within 24 hours' vs free 'within 48 hours' — a mild queue nudge.
countsAsLive: The tool has a public detail page under aitoolzdir.com/toolz/<slug> (or category listing) and you received the approval confirmation email.
unknowns: Whether an account is required (the form showed email capture but no visible login gate).
How often the reciprocal backlink is re-checked.
What happens to the listing if the tool is later discontinued.
